root_cause: FanDuel CFB transport read only the NCAAF landing page, while standard player passing/rushing/receiving props live on the event-page popular tab.
FanDuel live market aliases Passing Yds, Rushing Yds, Passing TDs, and Any Time Touchdown Scorer were not all normalized by the adapter.
FanDuel standard O/U runners include side text in runnerName, for example Roman Gagliano Over, which failed exact roster identity matching.
FanDuel American prices are nested under americanDisplayOdds and the prior parser dropped them to null.
implementation: fetch exactly one FanDuel event-page popular tab for each verified slate game
preserve exact verified-game binding before any prop row is emitted
normalize current FanDuel CFB market-name aliases
derive exact player identity from the market title before exact roster reconciliation
parse nested FanDuel American prices without converting missing values to zero
ignore alternate one-sided ladders unless they satisfy the existing two-way supported-market contract
